mapper.sql: credential_id credentialId,tenant_id tenantId,key_prefix keyPrefix,credential_name credentialName, expires_time expiresTime,status storedStatus,rotated_from_id rotatedFromId,version,create_time createTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_api_credential WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND credential_id=#{credentialId}
SELECT FROM t_api_credential WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND credential_id=#{credentialId} FOR UPDATE

mapper.update: UPDATE t_api_credential SET status='REVOKED',version=version+1,update_time=#{now} WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('ACTIVE','EXPIRED')
UPDATE t_api_credential SET expires_time=#{expiresTime},version=version+1,update_time=#{now} WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT credential_id credentialId, scope_code scopeCode FROM t_api_credential_scope WHERE credential_id IN #{id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND effective_from<=#{asOf} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{asOf}) ORDER BY credential_id, scope_code
SELECT scope_code FROM t_api_scope WHERE scope_code IN #{code}
